ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
summary: Safe motherhood intervention promoting institutional delivery among pregnant women, especially from poor families.
benefits: Cash assistance for institutional delivery, amount varying by rural/urban residence and state category.
eligibility: Pregnant women, with focus on those from BPL families and low-performing states
Delivering at a government or accredited private facility
application_steps: Register pregnancy at the nearest Anganwadi/health facility
